verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public REST API (OpenAPI 3.1) and an MCP server that can find and read mail. These are developer building blocks from which an export could be built, not a documented bulk export of scan PDFs and mail-history metadata. Cloud access to digital copies and unlimited storage are also not an export capability, so this applicable axis has no direct support.

support.subject: As an operator, I can export my scans and mail history in bulk — PDFs and metadata leave the platform when I do

citations.quote: The OpenAPI 3.1 specification is available as a YAML file for import into tools like Postman, Swagger UI, or code generators.
Use APIs to connect your virtual mailbox to the tools you already use, so your documents and mail stay in sync and your work keeps moving.
